CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository hosts Active Directory Extras, a community-maintained fork of dlandon's original active.directory plugin for Unraid. It adds a settings page for tuning Samba/winbind Active Directory idmap behavior and persists winbind's TDB databases across reboots.
This fork was created after the original GitHub repository was removed and the author became unresponsive to maintenance questions. All original credit belongs to Dan Landon; this repository exists to keep the plugin functional and maintained on current Unraid releases.
For support, bug reports, or feature requests, please open an issue on GitHub rather than posting in the original (unmaintained) forum thread.
